introduction: Welcome to ClearSight Vision Center. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal health information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
agreement: By using our website or services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.personal: We collect: identification (name, DOB, gender), contact information (address, email, phone), health information (medical history, prescriptions, insurance), financial information, technical data (IP address, browser), and usage data.
collection.phi: As a healthcare provider, we collect Protected Health Information (PHI) including medical records, test results, treatment plans, insurance details, and care communications.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.purposes: Healthcare services (appointments, treatment, records), website improvement, marketing communications (with consent), and legal compliance.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis (GDPR)
legalBasis.bases: We process data based on: Consent, Contract fulfillment, Legal obligations (HIPAA), Legitimate interests, and Vital interests (emergencies).

sharing.title: 4. Sharing Your Information
sharing.parties: We share with healthcare providers, service providers, and as legally required. We DO NOT sell your information.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.periods: Medical records: 7+ years. Financial: 7 years. Marketing consent: Until withdrawn. Analytics: 26 months. Logs: 90 days.

rights.title: 6. Your Privacy Rights
rights.list: Access, Correction, Deletion, Restriction, Portability, Withdraw Consent, HIPAA rights to medical records and accounting of disclosures.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.types: Necessary (required), Analytics (optional), Marketing (optional), Functional (optional). Manage via our Cookie Center.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.measures: 256-bit encryption, firewalls, audits, multi-factor auth, HIPAA compliance, physical security, staff training.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.policy: Not directed to under 13. Parental consent required for minors under 18.

international.title: 10. International Transfers
international.info: Data may be transferred to US. We use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and ensure adequate safeguards.

hipaa.title: 11. HIPAA Compliance
hipaa.compliance: We comply with HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules. Full Notice of Privacy Practices available at office and website.

ccpa.title: 12. California Rights (CCPA)
ccpa.rights: Right to Know, Delete, Opt-Out (we don't sell data), Non-Discrimination. Contact privacy@clearsightvision.com

changes.title: 13. Policy Changes
changes.notification: We'll notify via website, email, and consent updates. Continued use = acceptance.

contact.title: 14. Contact Us
contact.hhs: HHS Office for Civil Rights: 1-877-696-6775, www.hhs.gov/ocr/privacy
